message.text: The new tests distinguish missing locks and different process IDs, but never distinguish two claims from the same process. Comparing only the PID instead of the complete claim would pass the tests I read.

explanation.what: The new tests distinguish missing locks and different process IDs, but never distinguish two claims from the same process. Comparing only the PID instead of the complete claim would pass the tests I read.
explanation.whatToDo: Add a lock-replacement case using process.pid and a different UUID, asserting status 2, unchanged pending results, and preservation of the replacement lock.
explanation.whyHere: The random claim is the new mechanism that distinguishes runs, including concurrent measureParity calls in one process; checking its format in endDuring does not check that ownership uses it.

properties.failureScenario: Mutate holds() to compare readFileSync(this.path, "utf8").split(" ")[0] with this.claim.split(" ")[0]. The replacement test uses '999 other\n', so still rejects it; the missing-lock test still rejects, and normal runs still succeed. If run A's lock is replaced by run B's claim with the same process.pid but a different UUID, A would instead save its results and delete B's lock. No read test exercises that distinction.
